definitions.explanation: Running a test, measurement, or examination a second time, usually to confirm an abnormal result, monitor a change, or double-check a decision. Most often heard in medical contexts — for example, after a health check-up returns borderline numbers — but also used for inspections and technical tests in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、{再検査|さいけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I will have a follow-up test next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{再検査|さいけんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Based on the health check-up results, I was told I needed a follow-up test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数値|すうち}→数値：12913_suuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再検査|さいけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指示|しじ}した→指示する：26845_shijisuru⟧。
examples.english: Because there was an abnormality in the blood values, the doctor ordered a follow-up test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ロット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{再検査|さいけんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Because a defect was found in the factory's products, a reexamination was carried out on all the lots.

notes:
Composed of the prefix ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) + ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (inspection, examination, test). Appears most frequently in the medical phrase {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to undergo a follow-up test), since Japanese annual health check-ups routinely flag borderline values and ask the patient to come back for confirmation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to undergo a follow-up test
- {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ: a follow-up test is needed
- {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧よう⟦{指示|しじ}する→指示する：26845_shijisuru⟧: to instruct (someone) to undergo a follow-up test
- {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: notice of the need for a follow-up test
- ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再検査|さいけんさ}: a follow-up blood test

VERBAL USE:
The word can take ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to act as a verb: {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to reexamine, to retest. In that form, the subject is the one doing the checking: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数値|すうち}→数値：12913_suuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{再検査|さいけんさ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (the doctor retested the values). In patient-side usage the passive-like {再検査|さいけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ is much more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精密|せいみつ}{検査|けんさ}→精密検査：20629_seimitsukensa⟧: detailed examination / thorough test — a more in-depth follow-up, usually ordered when the initial screening shows a clear problem.
- ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: additional test — tests added on top of what was originally planned, not necessarily a redo.
- ⟦{再診|さいしん}→再診：23254_saishin⟧: a return visit to the doctor — refers to the appointment itself, not to the test.

USAGE:
Beyond medicine, you will encounter the word in quality control (factory inspections, food safety), academic contexts (retaking a test), and engineering (retesting equipment). In all these uses, it keeps the core sense of "checking again."
